page.notes: The line "Lib.1." is doubtful: the printed numeral after "Lib." is unclear and may be "1" or another figure. The long s is printed as f throughout and is transcribed as s. Catchword "dixeris" stands at the lower right and is not repeated in the text. Possible printing error: "Etenim" line is printed with the verb "necessum" and is normalised to "necessum". Body text is set in italic type throughout; headings and marginal notes are roman.
